content.text:
Three structural changes:

**`PathfindingStrategies` namespace class** — a non-instantiable container whose static inner classes hold all concrete algorithm implementations. `PathfindingStrategies.FloydWarshall` replaces the top-level `FloydWarshallStrategy`. Adding Dijkstra or Bellman-Ford means adding a class inside this container and a `register` call — nothing outside the namespace changes.

**`StrategyRegistry`** — a `HashMap`-backed registry that maps string keys to strategy instances. The static initializer self-registers all known strategies at class-load time. `get()` throws a descriptive exception on unknown names rather than returning null. New strategies can also be registered at runtime via `StrategyRegistry.register(...)`, which enables plugin-style extension without recompilation.

**`main`** — the client now references only `"floyd-warshall"` as a string. It has no import or instantiation dependency on any concrete strategy class. Swapping to a different algorithm at runtime is a one-character change to the lookup key.
